create_web_error: create a WebError instance with an event loop, dispatcher fiber, page, and Error object
access_web_error_page: access the page property from a WebError instance to retrieve the associated Page
access_web_error_error: access the error property from a WebError instance to retrieve the underlying Error object
review_web_error_class: review the WebError class that wraps a page and error for internal Playwright use
test_web_error_init: test the WebError __init__ method accepts an event loop, dispatcher fiber, optional page, and Error
